from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyExpenditure(BaseModel):
    """One company's non-operating expenditure amount from a single financial statement."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as named in the financial report")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period for this financial data, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")
    non_operating_expenditure: float | None = Field(description="The amount of non-operating expenditures (营业外支出)")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit of the amount, e.g., '元'")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the label and amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_expenditures: list[CompanyExpenditure]
